items.docs:
Create a new user account and send a verification email.

Args:
    data: Registration details (username, email, password).
    session: Database session.

Returns:
    The created user's basic info with a confirmation message.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 if username or email already exists.

Verify a user's email address using a signed token.

Args:
    data: The verification token.
    session: Database session.

Returns:
    Confirmation message.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 if token is invalid or expired.

Resend verification email for an unverified account.

Always returns 200 with a generic message to prevent email enumeration.

Send a password reset email if the email exists.

Always returns 200 with a generic message to prevent email enumeration.

Args:
    data: The email address to send the reset link to.
    session: Database session.

Returns:
    Generic confirmation message (regardless of whether the email exists).

Reset a user's password using a signed, one-time-use token.

Args:
    data: The reset token and new password.
    session: Database session.

Returns:
    Confirmation message.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 if token is invalid, expired, or already consumed.

Get a CSRF token for cross-domain requests.

This endpoint is provided for UI compatibility. With JWT-based
authentication, CSRF tokens are not strictly necessary since
the auth token is sent in the Authorization header (not cookies).

However, the frontend may still expect this endpoint to exist.

Returns:
    A CSRF token.

Authenticate user with username and password.

Args:
    data: Login credentials.
    session: Database session.

Returns:
    Access and refresh tokens with user info.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 if credentials invalid.

Logout the current user.

Clears the JWT cookie so browser-based sessions are terminated immediately.

Get information about the currently logged in user.

Args:
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The current user's information.

info.name: Search users by name or email

items.docs:
Search users by first name, last name, username, or email.

Returns empty list if search term is less than 3 characters.
Excludes service accounts from results.

Staff-only for general search (matching Django IsAdminUser).
Non-staff users may search within an anonymous workspace (returns only
anonymized results).

Search users by exact email address match.

Returns matching users and list of emails not found.
Used for mapping git contributors to user accounts.

Note: Accepts both `q` and `q[]` query parameter formats for compatibility
with different frontend frameworks.

info.name: Get access token for API usage

items.docs:
Generate an access token for the current user.

The token can be used for API authentication with Bearer scheme.

info.name: Get users in current user's network

items.docs:
Get users who share workspaces with the current user.

Workspace name to scope results to (required).
Returns users who have permissions on the specified workspace.
Useful for autocomplete/mentions.

Args:
    workspace: Workspace name to scope results to (required).
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    session: Database session.

Returns:
    List of users in the current user's network.

Get a user by their ID.

Args:
    user_id: The ID of the user to retrieve.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user (required for auth).

Returns:
    The user information.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if user not found.

Update user details.

Users can only update their own profile. Admins can update any user.

Args:
    user_id: The ID of the user to update.
    update_data: The fields to update.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    session: Database session.

Returns:
    The updated user information.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 if trying to update another user's profile.
    HTTPException: 404 if user not found.

Get workspaces sorted by user's activity count.

Args:
    user_id: The user ID.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    List of workspaces with activity counts.

Get the count of activities for a user (heatmap data).

Returns a list of date/count pairs for generating activity heatmaps.

Args:
    user_id: The user ID.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    List of date/count pairs.

Get activity stream for a user.

Args:
    user_id: The user ID.
    page: Page number.
    page_size: Items per page.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    List of activities.
